verdict.rationale: Finix documents API-driven seller onboarding for platforms (custom onboarding via API, onboarding forms) plus onboarding notifications and webhooks, so an agent could create and onboard sellers through the API using sandbox/live credentials. The official MCP server is documentation-only: it answers questions about the Finix API and does not perform seller operations. missing for 10: an MCP surface that executes seller operations, evidence of handling requirements-due / outstanding-verification states, scoped or restricted API credentials beyond sandbox vs. live, and independent hands-on corroboration.
